description: List epics for the current board in the lean camelCase shape (description/hypothesis/successMetrics omitted by default — opt back in via include, or pass view:"summary" for id/title/stage/outcomeStatus only). Returns { total, showing, epics } so a limit never truncates silently.

include.description: Heavy epic fields to opt back into the default shape. Ignored when view:"summary".

limit.description: Max epics to return (default: all). The response carries total + showing so truncation is always visible.

view.description: summary → { id, title, stage, outcomeStatus }. Omit (or "full") for the default lean shape (camelCase-only, description/hypothesis/successMetrics omitted).

name: list_epics
